title: 問い合わせを、担当へ。— 動く説明図
authored_by: Claude Opus 5.5 (diagram, motion and film code). Values come from the saved original run; nothing is generated or executed by the film.
message: 1件の問い合わせ（封筒）が、上から順の判定で担当の机に届き、実際の引き継ぎメモになる。判定は値の比較で、AI の分類ではない。

data.dsl: assets/workflow.yml (sha256 d36f345c08705992f654571d35676a211bcae62abcfb6171c8655b308ab0776f, original bytes; read as text for 7 nodes, 8 edges, rule order)

refs.memo: cases[Dxx].output.text lines 1 (【担当】…), 3 (件名：…) and 4 (…／影響N人); equals the memo node output and GraphRunSucceededEvent.outputs.text
refs.counts: selected_case_id over the 8 cases: urgent 3 / billing 1 / false 4 (also independent-checks.json route_counts)

inbox.form: dashed tray labelled 問い合わせ; always visible

envelope.identity: one envelope per record journey; the same object morphs home → token → memo (or half memo) with a continuous rectangle
envelope.home: large envelope: record ID, ticket ID, three stamps (bill = 種類, bolt = 緊急度, people = 人数)
envelope.token: small envelope with record ID and a stripe: accent before the desk, route colour after it
envelope.under: hidden while passing through the matched rule cell and the desk (drawn beneath them)
envelope.memo: unfolds at the end node into the actual memo: line 1, the 件名 line, badge 実際のメモ, record ID and ticket ID

switch.order: portrait left → right, wide top → bottom; numbered

end.form: memo slot labelled 引き継ぎメモ

objects.edges: 8 lines always drawn in grey with arrowheads; taken edges trace in colour as the envelope passes

layouts.native: Each orientation has its own coordinates (no letterbox scaling). Other sizes from window.renderConfig scale the nearest layout uniformly.

scenes.conveys: One connected picture: envelope → ordered switch → 3 desks → まとめる → memo.
scenes.enter: Full network and the D02 envelope at the inbox from frame 0 (no blank frame).
scenes.motion: Routes light one after another (優先対応 → 請求窓口 → 通常窓口) with small actual counts 3件 / 1件 / 4件.
scenes.exit: Route highlights and counts fade at 4.7–5.2 s.

scenes.conveys: 請求・通常・1人: rule 1 ×, rule 2 ✓ → 請求窓口.
scenes.enter: The same D02 envelope shrinks into the token at 5.1 s.
scenes.motion: start→route, marks from condition_results, through cell 2, desk, merge, end; unfolds into the actual billing memo by 8.8 s.
scenes.exit: Memo slides right and fades at 10.0–10.4 s.

scenes.conveys: 請求・至急・2人: rule 1 ✓ first; rule 2 was not evaluated (dimmed), only the urgent template ran.
scenes.enter: D06 envelope drops into the inbox at 10.0 s.
scenes.motion: Same path shape through cell 1 → 優先対応 desk → memo by 13.4 s.
scenes.note: D02 and D06 are separate recorded inputs; urgency and user count both differ. Rule order illustration, not live editing.

scenes.conveys: Two distinct records: D04 (99人) → 通常窓口, D05 (100人) → 優先対応. Among the three routing fields only the user count differs; ticket ID, subject and body also differ.
scenes.enter: D04 envelope at 15.0 s; D05 envelope at 18.2 s.
scenes.motion: A number tag (actual_value) leaves the token and lands under 「100人以上」 with the recorded result: 99 ＜ 100 ×, 100 ≥ 100 ✓. D04's memo parks as the left half (18.6 s) and its path dims; D05's memo unfolds as the right half by 20.8 s. Each half shows its own record ID, ticket ID and 影響N人 from its own memo.

scenes.conveys: The subject literal {{ 7 * 7 }} travels with the envelope and appears unchanged in the actual 通常窓口 memo.
scenes.enter: D07 envelope with the literal tag at 22.0 s.
scenes.motion: Rules 1, 2 × then ほか ✓; the literal rides above the token and lands in the memo's 件名 line by 25.6 s.
scenes.limits: Drawn as text only; nothing is evaluated or executed. Not a security test. The <script> body line stays in the folded raw record, not in the film.

scenes.conveys: Held connected picture with the actual D05 memo, counts 3 / 1 / 4 and a save prompt.
scenes.enter: D05 envelope at 27.0 s, faster pass.
scenes.motion: Memo settled by 29.5 s; counts and CTA 「作例ページで JSON・DSL を保存」 from 29.2–29.5 s.

text_rules.headline: At most one readable headline: old fades out 0.3 s before the boundary, new fades in 0.3 s after it.
text_rules.eyebrow: Small record line (記録 Dxx ・ T-xxx ・ 種類・緊急度・人数) in accent; changes with the envelope.
never: claims of AI classification, LLM use, server or difyctl

limits.not_tested: Dify server / console / API / Docker / difyctl / web UI import, LLM, semantic classification, summary, knowledge, tools, plugins, form validation, performance.
limits.review_status: Rendering, frame review, native playback and packaging are performed by the production side after this source; not claimed here.
